purpose: Bounded full-action-expert single-episode fit; test whether limited trainable action capacity explains the failed rose imitation gate.
initialization: Fresh published VLABench primitive reference; unchanged upstream normalization, Euler label convention, sampler and deployment controller.
failed_prior_diagnostic: Published rose reference passes 3/3 at 211 controls; all tested rose SFT recipes, including action-quantile refitting and lr1e-6, failed the first complete execution.
next_step: Keep result as a single-episode diagnostic, retain all failed candidates and do not use it to initialize a reported multitask result.

changed_factors.action_parameters: All group-1 action expert weights plus projection/time heads; VLM frozen; no LoRA.
changed_factors.microbatch_grouping: 2 by 4 instead of 4 by 2; effective batch remains 8.

diagnostic_limit: One fixed training reset only. A success preserves/adapts a capability the reference already has; no acquisition, improvement or generalization claim.
storage_budget: One final policy/Adam checkpoint, estimated 5 GiB; no intermediate checkpoint, no asset download, no deletion.
stop_rule: Run only this declared 100-update candidate. Reject after its first complete autonomous failure. Keep PPO paused until a shared two-task checkpoint is validated.
